onset.Description: Onset of the image, from the first data point.

duration.Description: 0: the event marks the image onset.

value.Description: 1-based position of the image in NSD's shared1000 list (sharedix in code/0_data_collection/nsd_expdesign.mat); stim_file names the image.

sample.Description: Onset in samples, from the first data point (0).

stim_file.Description: NSD image shown at this onset, relative to stimuli/: the COCO image cropped by NSD's cropBox and resized to 425x425 (code/crop_stimuli.py).
